Class HateoasAwareSpringDataWebConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.web.config.SpringDataWebConfiguration
org.springframework.data.web.config.HateoasAwareSpringDataWebConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanClassLoaderAware, WebMvcConfigurer
@Configuration(proxyBeanMethods=false) public class HateoasAwareSpringDataWebConfiguration extends SpringDataWebConfiguration
JavaConfig 类用于注册 PagedResourcesAssembler、PagedResourcesAssemblerArgumentResolver、SlicedResourcesAssembler 和 SlicedResourcesAssemblerArgumentResolver。
Since:
1.6
Author:
Oliver Gierke，Nick Williams，Ben Hale，Vedran Pavic，Mark Paluch，Greg Turnquist，Michael Schout
